title: athyrium nigripes var. clarkei
intro: Athyrium nigripes var. clarkei, commonly known as Clarke's Lady Fern, is a fern species that belongs to the Athyrium genus. It has been used in traditional medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The health benefits of Clarke's Lady Fern include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing digestive issues and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic compounds, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
